items.titleEn: Every word of Mikel’s pre-Forest press conference
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta was back in front of the media at the Sobha Realty Training Centre for his pre-Nottingham Forest press conference
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta was back in front of the media at the Sobha Realty Training Centre for his pre-Nottingham Forest press conference on Friday.
Our manager was asked to share the latest team news, provide his thoughts on Oliver Glasner’s side and more.
Here’s everything he had to say on the following subjects…

on the last two matches:We have responded really well in the last two games, two very good performances and results, and now we just focus on the game against Forest, which I know is going to be a really tough one.

on the last two trips to the City Ground ending goalless:We're going to try really hard to score goals and to prevent goals as well. It’s going to be a really tough match, they’re an extremely well-coached team. We know that, we already have experience with Oliver [Glasner] in the past and they’re a team that at home that can create a really special momentum, so we are ready for it.

on scoring more goals from open play than set-pieces:We are getting criticised for scoring goals! Regardless of the manner that we score them, the team is showing a great attacking flow. We’ve scored some beautiful goals but the value of the goals is exactly the same, so I think we have to be a team that is able to score in many, many ways and that will make it harder for the opponent.

on injury news:Piero is evolving really well. Knowing his character and the way he pushes everybody, I'm sure it's not going to take long, I think, but he will probably need another week or two. Zubi looks much better, he already looked much better today. We have another session tomorrow, and after that will assess whether he's available to play against Forest.
on if Hincapie could be back before the international break:I'm very hopeful, but we have to see how this evolves.

on Christos Tzolis’s recovery:He’s doing really well. Yesterday he had another MRI scan to see how the injury is evolving. It's progressing really well, so he’s another one that hopefully we can have back in a few weeks.

on whether Saliba could be back before the international break:I think next week we have another MRI with him to see how the healing process is at the moment, but every sign so far has been very, very positive. It will be great to have him.

on William missing the team photo:What happened was that we have tried to do that picture three times already, but we have had to cancel it at the last minute for different reasons. We have some commercial obligations and had people who came and flew over to do that, so we decided to do that picture at least. We'll have another picture with the whole family. Hopefully we can get them all together at some point one day, and will announce that as well.
on if we’re going to re-take the picture:Yes.
on if Saliba’s happy about that:It wasn't in his hands. Normally he's happy about everything. He knows how much loved he is. They were taking some banter all of the players. He's completely fine.

on the way Timber is progressing:We can see the importance of him in the team. When he's physically at his best, he's an unbelievable player. A player that can really transform your way of attacking. The aggression that he has in the defending part of the game. And a real character as well on that pitch. Great to have him at that level.

on news regarding redundancies at the club:Well said, first, because this question is not for me. I was explained about the exercise and analysis that has been done across the club. And with the intention always to evolve, to improve, some decisions have to be taken to put people in the right roles and keep investing to achieve what we want to achieve, and the success that we want to create. So that's been explained. Obviously I'm not the right person to answer that question, that's for sure. And hopefully everybody will respect that.

on Lewis-Skelly’s versatility:We just discussed that a few days ago. Because we had a doubt when a player is in such a good moment, playing a certain position, to change him is not ideal. But we had an injury with Piero, and we knew that at some point we were going to need it with the schedule that we have. He responded incredibly well. I think he had a big performance the other night, and that shows you the maturity, the capacity to adapt, the intelligence of the player, and he's in a really good moment.

on what we’ve discussed with him about his role:We always made him aware. Especially when we have some thoughts, to be prepared and to understand first of all the role, and to understand the things that he needs to dominate in that specific game. And he's very open and he knows that as well, being able to play in different positions. As a six, as an eight, as a full-back, he’s going to open more possibilities to play, and that's a massive asset and he's got the capacity to do that.

on Forest struggling at the start of the season:Yes, but in some games it was the result, because in terms of the performance and what they deserve for the game, it should have been very, very different, and we are very aware of that.

on Gyokeres:These are moments in a player's career. Or in a season, I would say, and we are trying to help him as much as possible. He has some very good moments. He's three or four times in front of goal with no keeper, and the ball should arrive to him, and it doesn't. And maybe they are talking about something else, but these are the strikers. It's very small margins. Scoring or not scoring changes the narrative. We should know the perception of how much he can help the team.

on if players are being overworked with so many games coming up:The thought is how we recover them and get them in the best possible condition for the next match. Because that's not going to change. It's a lot of talk about it. Let's see what the action is after the season. But it doesn't look like it's going to change.

on what Ken Friar meant to us:Well as I said in the press conference after the match, I think if you had to embody someone to represent the soul and heart of this football club, that would be him. I think the way he came to the club and the way he leaves the club, the legacy he leaves in between, in so many different roles, in so many different moments of the club, is something that is incredibly difficult to achieve. He’s done it through his full commitment to the club, the love for the club, and doing it in a manner that it was so special, because he was a character, he had a personality, an aura. Anybody that has met him [knows] that he was different to anybody else.

on how the last few months have been for Timber mentally:It’s been a challenge, but it’s true that, obviously, he overcame a really difficult one as well in the first competitive match with Arsenal, when he injured his ACL. So he has some background and some experience on that. I think he has used this time as well to challenge himself in other areas, probably to value more the profession and the fact that when you are available and you have the opportunity to play, it’s just one of the best things that can happen to you. I think he’s pushed so hard because he had some difficult moments and he’s pushed so hard with the people next to him to get back to this level.

on the relationship between Timber and White:Unbelievable. I just had the two of them in my office, reviewing the game. The way they talk to each other, the way they respect each other, the way they like each other, it’s just a joy. That’s why when somebody plays, the other one is there to support him and that’s what we need because with the amount of games that we play, it cannot be any different.

on Guimaraes hitting the ground running after a busy international break:There were a few factors. They arrived to London on Sunday night, so we almost had six days before the game, and because they’ve been travelling and training, the temptation [is] OK, land here on Sunday, get the check-in and give them two or three days off, they can go to Marbella; no Marbella. They were in India, they were in Australia, what they needed is recovery, sleep, eat well, have some proper training and have a day off and two days to prepare the game. I think that changed a lot because otherwise they would have been in a very different position.

on if he can add to his goalscoring numbers:One of the best attributes is a player that is constantly playing to have the position, whether it’s with passes, whether it is with runs, with shots, as you mentioned, and you could see his numbers last year as well. He’s a player that has to add a lot of value and impact in the final third.

on if Gyokeres is struggling with confidence:That’s a very personal question. I think what he transmits is an incredible will and determination and work rate to improve and help the team, that’s it. That’s Viktor every single day, regardless of his position, whether he scores a goal or not, and that’s why he’s always an option to play.

on if we’re light in the left wing position with Tzolis injured:Well obviously when somebody misses a few weeks, you are lighter. Light? I don’t know. But you are certainly lighter. Are we lighter as a left-back? Yes. Are we lighter at centre-back [than] when Mosquera was there? Yes. So that’s what we want, players that are available and robust enough to be available always, and when they’re not, somebody else. The good thing is that somebody has come in, whether it’s Ebz or Noni in this case, and they still perform and do really well.

items.titleZh: 米克尔赛前新闻发布会全纪录
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅米克尔·阿尔特塔在索布哈 realty 训练基地出席了对阵诺丁汉森林的赛前新闻发布会。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔于周五在索布哈雷尔蒂训练基地出席了对阵诺丁汉森林前的媒体见面会。
我们的主教练被问及分享最新的球队伤病情况、对奥利弗·格拉斯纳球队的看法等内容。
以下是他对以下话题的全部言论……
关于过去两场比赛：我们在过去两场比赛中做出了非常好的回应，有两场非常出色的表现和结果，现在我们只专注于对阵森林队的比赛，我知道这将是一场非常艰难的比赛。
关于过去两次客场城市球场均以零比零收场：我们将全力以赴去进球，并阻止对手进球。这将是一场非常艰难的比赛，他们是一支执教水平极高的球队。我们知道这一点，我们过去已经和奥利弗[格拉斯纳]有过交手经验，他们是一支在主场能够营造出非常特殊势头的球队，所以我们已经做好了准备。
关于运动战进球多于定位球进球：我们因为进球而受到批评！无论我们以什么方式进球，球队都展现出了极佳的进攻流畅度。我们打进了一些漂亮的进球，但进球的价值完全一样，所以我认为我们必须成为一支能够通过多种方式进球的球队，这会让对手更难防守。
关于伤病消息：皮耶罗恢复得非常好。了解他的性格以及他推动每个人的方式，我确信这不会花太长时间，但我认为他可能还需要一到两周的时间。祖比看起来好多了，他今天看起来已经好多了。我们明天还有一堂训练课，之后将评估他是否可以参加对阵森林队的比赛。
关于因卡皮耶是否能在国际比赛日前复出：我非常充满希望，但我们必须看情况如何发展。
关于克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯的恢复情况：他恢复得很好。昨天他又做了一次核磁共振扫描，以查看伤情进展。进展非常顺利，所以他也是另一个我们希望能在几周内复出的球员。
关于萨利巴是否能在国际比赛日前复出：我认为下周我们将为他做另一次核磁共振检查，以了解目前的愈合过程，但到目前为止的每一个迹象都非常非常积极。能拥有他将是棒极了。
关于威廉缺席全家福拍摄：事情是这样的，我们已经尝试拍过三次那张照片了，但由于各种原因，我们不得不在最后时刻取消了它。我们有一些商业义务，也有特意飞过来的人，所以我们决定至少把那张照片拍了。我们还将拍摄一张全家福。希望有一天我们能把他们全部聚在一起，我们也会宣布这一消息。
关于我们是否会重新拍那张照片：是的。
关于萨利巴对此是否高兴：这不由他掌控。通常他对一切都很高兴。他知道自己有多受爱戴。球员们之间开了一些玩笑。他完全没问题。
关于廷伯的进展方式：我们可以看到他在球队中的重要性。当他的身体处于最佳状态时，他是一名不可思议的球员。一个真正能改变你进攻方式的球员。他在防守比赛中所展现出的侵略性。球场上也是一个真正有个性的人。很高兴他能达到那个水平。
关于俱乐部裁员的消息：说得好，首先，因为这个问题不适合问我。有人向我解释了俱乐部范围内所做的演练和分析。为了不断发展、改进，必须做出一些决定，把合适的人放在正确的岗位上，并继续投资以实现我们想要达到的目标，创造我们想要的成功。所以这些都已经解释过了。显然我不是回答这个问题合适的人，这是肯定的。希望大家能尊重这一点。
关于刘易斯-斯凯利的全面性：我们几天前刚刚讨论过这一点。因为当一名球员状态正佳、踢特定位置时，我们对改变他感到有所顾虑，这并非理想情况。但皮耶罗受伤了，而且我们知道根据赛程安排，我们在某个时刻会需要他。他的回应好得令人难以置信。我认为他在前天晚上的比赛中表现出色，这向你展示了球员的成熟度、适应能力、智慧，他目前状态正佳。
关于我们和他讨论的关于他的角色的内容：我们总是让他知情。特别是当我们有一些想法时，要做好准备，首先要理解这个角色，并理解他需要在特定比赛中掌握的事情。他是非常开放的，他也知道这一点，能够胜任不同的位置。作为六号位、八号位或边后卫，他将开启更多的可能性，这是一个巨大的资产，他有能力做到这一点。
关于森林队赛季初表现挣扎：是的，但在某些比赛中这是结果问题，因为就表现以及他们在比赛中应得的结果而言，本应该非常非常不同，我们对此非常清楚。
关于哲凯赖什：这些是球员职业生涯中的时刻。或者说是一个赛季中的时刻，我想说，我们正在尽最大努力帮助他。他有一些非常好的时刻。他有三四次面对空门没有门将的机会，球本该传给他，但却没有。也许他们在谈论别的事情，但这就是前锋。差距非常微小。进球或不进球会改变叙事。我们应该知道人们对他能在多大程度上帮助球队的看法。
关于随着即将到来的比赛增多，球员是否过度劳累：我们的想法是如何恢复他们，并让他们以最佳状态迎接下一场比赛。因为这一点不会改变。有很多关于这方面的讨论。让我们看看赛季结束后会有什么行动。但看起来它不会改变。

关于肯·弗里尔对我们的意义：正如我在赛后新闻发布会上所说的那样，我认为如果你必须找一个人来代表这家足球俱乐部的灵魂和心脏，那就是他。我认为他来到俱乐部的方式、他离开俱乐部的方式，以及他在其中留下的遗产，在这么多不同的角色中，在俱乐部的这么多不同时刻，是极其难以实现的。他通过对俱乐部的全心全意、对俱乐部的热爱，并以一种非常特殊的方式做到了这一点，因为他是一个有性格、有脾气、有气场的人。任何见过他的人都知道他与众不同。
关于廷伯过去几个月在精神上的经历：这是一个挑战，但确实，显然他在阿森纳的第一场正式比赛中十字韧带受伤时，也克服了一个非常困难的挑战。所以他有一些背景和经验。我认为他也利用这段时间在其他领域挑战自己，也许更懂得珍惜这个职业，当你保持健康并有机会上场时，这是可能发生在你身上最好的事情之一。我认为他非常努力，因为他经历了一些困难时刻，他和身边的人一起非常努力地恢复到了这个水平。
关于廷伯和怀特之间的关系：难以置信。我刚刚把他们两个叫进我的办公室，回顾了比赛。他们交谈的方式、他们尊重对方的方式、他们喜欢对方的方式，真是一种享受。这就是为什么当一个人上场时，另一个人会在那里支持他，这就是我们所需要的，因为鉴于我们踢的比赛数量，情况不可能有所不同。

关于吉马良斯在密集的国际比赛日后迅速进入状态：有几个因素。他们在周日晚上抵达伦敦，所以我们在比赛前几乎有六天的时间，而且因为他们一直在旅行和训练，诱惑就是——好吧，周日在这里着陆，办理入住，然后给他们放两三天假，他们可以去马尔贝拉；没有马尔贝拉。他们在印度，他们在澳大利亚，他们需要的是恢复、睡眠、吃得好、进行适当的训练，并有一天假和两天来准备比赛。我认为这改变了很多，否则他们就会处于非常不同的位置。
关于他能否增加进球数：最好的属性之一就是球员不断地通过传球、跑动或射门来占据位置，正如你所提到的，你也可以看到他去年的数据。他是一名必须在进攻三区增加很多价值和影响力的球员。
关于哲凯赖什是否在自信心上挣扎：这是一个非常个人的问题。我认为他传达的是一种令人难以置信的意愿、决心和工作效率，以提高自己并帮助球队，就是这样。维克托每天都是如此，无论他的位置如何，无论他是否进球，这就是为什么他总是上场的备选之一。
关于随着齐奥利斯受伤，我们在左翼位置上是否人手单薄：显然，当有人缺阵几周时，你的人手就会变少。单薄吗？我不知道。但你肯定人手变少了。我们的左后卫人手变少了吗？是的。与莫斯克拉在的时候相比，我们的中卫人手变少了吗？是的。所以这就是我们想要的，球员们要随时可用并且身体足够强壮，当他们不在时，由其他人顶上。好的一面是有人挺身而出，无论是埃布兹还是诺尼，他们依然表现出色。

items.titleEn: Arteta: “We’re showing great attacking flow”
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta comments on our impressive goalscoring record from open play ahead of the trip to Nottingham Forest
bodyEn: We recovered from a 3-0 defeat at Brighton prior to the international break with back-to-back wins over Leeds United and LOSC Lille at Emirates Stadium in the last week.
With five goals scored from us across those two matches, taking our total up to 21 for the season in all competitions, Mikel Arteta has been pleased with our end product.
The manager feels we’ll need to demonstrate more of the same in Sunday’s trip to Nottingham Forest in the Premier League.

“We have responded really well in the last two games, two very good performances and results, and now we just focus on the game against Forest, which I know is going to be a really tough one,” he said in his pre-match press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Friday.

“We're going to try really hard to score goals and to prevent goals as well. It’s going to be, as I said, a really tough match, extremely well-coached team. We know that we already had experience with Oliver [Glasner] in the past and a team that at home can create a really special momentum, so we are ready for it.”

Set-pieces were key to our success last season, with plenty of the goals coming from corners and free-kicks on our way to the league title, but it was pointed out to Mikel that, so far this season, 20 out of our 21 goals scored have come from open play.
But the boss responded by making the point that, as long as we’re scoring goals, it doesn’t matter too much how they go in!

“Look what you just said, [we got] criticism for scoring [set-piece] goals! I don't know what level we are at right now, but the team is showing a great attacking flow, we scored some beautiful goals,” he said.
“The value of the goals is exactly the same, so I think we have to be a team that is able to score in many, many ways. That will make it harder for the opponent.”

As for this weekend’s opponent, it’s been a bit of an underwhelming start to the campaign for Forest, who have managed to claim just five points from their opening six matches, most recently losing 3-1 away to Crystal Palace following a 1-0 defeat at home to Coventry City.
Mikel feels their results haven’t been entirely reflective of their performances, however.
“In some games it was the result, because in terms of the performance and what they deserve for the game, it should have been very, very different, and we are very aware of that,” he explained.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔：“我们展现出了出色的进攻流畅度”
items.summaryZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔在客场对阵诺丁汉森林前谈到了球队在阵地战中的出色进球纪录。
bodyZh: 在国际比赛日之前以0-3不敌布赖顿后，我们在过去一周里在酋长球场先后击败了利兹联和里尔，重回胜利轨道。
这两场比赛中我们攻入五球，各项赛事总进球数达到21粒，米克尔·阿尔特塔对我们的终结能力感到满意。
主教练认为，在周日客场对阵诺丁汉森林的英超联赛中，我们需要展现出同样的表现。
他在周五于索布哈地产训练中心举行的赛前新闻发布会上表示：“我们在过去两场比赛中做出了非常好的回应，奉献了两场出色的表现并取得了好的结果，现在我们只专注于对阵森林的比赛，我知道这将是一场非常艰难的比赛。”
“我们将全力以赴去进球并做好防守。正如我所说，这将是一场非常艰难的比赛，对手是一支执教水平极高的球队。我们知道过去已经与奥利弗有过交手经验，而且他们在主场能营造出非常特殊的势头，所以我们已经做好了准备。”
定位球是我们上赛季成功的关键，在我们夺得联赛冠军的路上，许多进球来自角球和任意球，但有人向米克尔指出，到目前为止本赛季我们的21个进球中有20个来自阵地战。
但主教练回应称，只要我们能进球，球是怎么进的并不是太重要！
他说：“看看你刚才说的，我们曾因打进定位球而受到批评！我不知道我们现在达到了什么水平，但球队展现出了极佳的进攻流畅度，我们打进了一些非常漂亮的进球。”
“进球的价值完全一样，所以我认为我们必须成为一支能够通过多种多样的方式进球的球队。这会增加对手防守的难度。”
至于本周末的对手，森林本赛季的开局有些令人失望，在前六场比赛中仅拿到5分，最近他们先是在主场0-1不敌考文垂，随后又在客场1-3输给水晶宫。
不过，米克尔认为他们的比赛结果并不能完全反映他们的场上表现。
他解释说：“在某些比赛中只是结果如此，就场上表现以及他们理应获得的回报而言，本应该大不相同，我们对此非常清楚。”

items.titleEn: Injury latest on Zubimendi, Hincapie, Tzolis and Saliba
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta has provided an update on the quartet ahead of our Premier League trip to Nottingham Forest on Sunday
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta hopes Martin Zubimendi will be fit to face Nottingham Forest on Sunday, but Piero Hincapie will likely miss out.
The duo picked up ankle injuries during a training session on the Emirates Stadium pitch after our win against Leeds United last week, and missed the midweek win over Lille.
However after further scans and rehab, Martin has been given every chance of being available at the City Ground by his boss, although it seems Piero could be a little further behind schedule.

Speaking in his pre-match press conference, Mikel said: “Piero is evolving really well. Knowing his character and the way he pushes everybody, I'm sure it's not going to take long, but he will probably need another week or two.
“Zubi looks much better, he already looked much better today. We have another session tomorrow, and after that we will assess whether he's available to play against Forest.”

We have two further players currently sidelined, including Christos Tzolis who picked up a muscular injury on international duty with Greece during the recent break, but Mikel is hopefully it’ll again be a matter of weeks, rather than months, until we see the winger back in red and white.

“He’s doing really well,” he revealed. “Yesterday he had another MRI scan to see how the injury is evolving. It's progressing really well, so he’s another one who hopefully we can have back in a few weeks.”
The other player who is currently out of action is William Saliba as he continues to recover from a back injury, which has kept him out since the end of France’s World Cup campaign.

The centre-back missed our annual squad photo this week because of a medical appointment, but Mikel eased concerns by saying Willo is also rehabbing well away from the rest of the squad, and he's keen to include him in a re-take so the whole Arsenal family can be together.
“I think next week we have another MRI with him to see how the healing process is at the moment, but every sign so far has been very, very positive,” Mikel added. “It will be great to have him.

“We have tried to do that picture three times already, but we have had to cancel it at the last minute for different reasons. We have some commercial obligations and had people who came and flew over to do that, so we decided to take that picture at least. We'll have another picture with the whole family when hopefully we can get them all together at some point.
“It wasn't in his hands, but normally he's happy about everything. He knows how loved he is. They were having some banter at the place, so he's completely fine.”

items.titleZh: 祖比门迪、因卡皮耶、佐利斯和萨利巴的伤情最新消息
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔更新了四名球员的伤情，球队将在周日英超客场对阵诺丁汉森林。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔希望马丁·祖比门迪能够在周日对阵诺丁汉森林的比赛中复出，但皮耶罗·因卡皮耶很可能缺阵。
这两人在上周战胜利兹联后，在酋长球场的一堂训练课中脚踝受伤，并缺席了周中对阵里尔的比赛。
然而，经过进一步的扫描和康复治疗，主帅表示马丁有很大希望在城市球场出场，不过皮耶罗的恢复进度似乎稍慢一些。
米克尔在赛前新闻发布会上表示：“皮耶罗恢复得非常好。了解他的性格以及他督促所有人的方式，我确信这不会花太长时间，但他可能还需要一到两周的时间。”
“祖比的情况看起来好多了，他今天看起来已经好多了。我们明天还有一堂训练课，之后我们将评估他是否能够对阵森林。”
目前我们还有另外两名球员因伤缺阵，其中包括克里斯托斯·佐利斯，他在最近的国际比赛日代表希腊队出场时肌肉受伤，但米克尔希望这位边锋重新穿上红白战袍只需要几周而不是几个月的时间。
他透露：“他恢复得非常好。昨天他又做了一次核磁共振扫描，以查看伤情进展。进展非常顺利，所以他也是另一个我们希望能在几周内迎回的球员。”
另一名目前无法出场的球员是威廉·萨利巴，他仍在从背部伤势中恢复，自法国队世界杯征程结束以来他一直缺阵。
由于有医疗预约，这位中卫本周缺席了我们的年度全队合影，但米克尔打消了人们的顾虑，称威利在球队之外的康复情况也很好，他渴望将他纳进补拍中，以便整个阿森纳大家庭能够聚在一起。
米克尔补充道：“我想下周我们要为他做另一次核磁共振，看看目前的愈合过程如何，但到目前为止所有迹象都非常非常积极。能有他回归太棒了。”
“我们已经尝试拍三次那张照片了，但由于各种原因不得不在最后时刻取消。我们有一些商业义务，有人飞过来完成拍摄，所以我们决定至少先把那张照片拍了。希望在某个时候我们能把所有人聚齐，再拍一张全家福。”
“这并不是他能控制的，但他通常对一切都很开心。他知道自己有多受喜爱。大家在那里开着玩笑，所以他完全没事。”

items.titleEn: Smilla Holmberg nominated for 2026 Golden Girl
items.summaryEn: Our Sweden international has been nominated for the 2026 award after an outstanding first year as a Gunner
bodyEn: Smilla Holmberg has been shortlisted for the 2026 Golden Girl Award after an impressive first year as an Arsenal player.

We signed the Sweden international from Hammarby in January this year, and she made her debut five days later, helping us keep a clean sheet in a goalless draw with Manchester United at Emirates Stadium.
Smilla has since scored three goals in 29 Arsenal appearances, including a dramatic stoppage-time equaliser against Manchester United in September this year.
Originally signed as a right-back, our no.31 has shown her versatility, thriving not only as a full-back but also as a midfielder and winger in her first year in north London.
Should Smilla win the award, we'd become the first club to have a player win the award in back-to-back seasons since it was introduced in 2022, after Michelle Agyemang won the award last year.
The 10 nominees are:

Alara – Bayern MunichIman Beney – Manchester CityVeerle Buurman – ChelseaGiulia Galli – BarcelonaAzzurra Gallo – ToulouseSmilla Holmberg – ArsenalMaeline Mendy – Paris FCSydney Schertenleib – BarcelonaFelicia Schröder – Real MadridClara Serrajordi – Barcelona
The Golden Girl Award recognises the brightest young footballers in Europe's top leagues, highlighting quality players under 21.
Since launching in 2022, Jule Brand, Linda Caicedo and three-time Champions League winner Vickey Lopez have all won the award, before Agyemang added her name to the illustrious list last year.

Smilla will be looking to become the first defender to win the Golden Girl, with the winner typically announced in early November, followed by a gala to celebrate the winner of both the Golden Girl and Golden Boy usually following in December.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳瑞典国脚在加盟后的首个出色年份后入围2026年金女孩奖候选。
bodyZh: 在度过了一个令人印象深刻的阿森纳生涯元年后，斯米拉-霍尔姆贝里入围了2026年金女孩奖的候选名单。
今年1月，我们从哈马比签下了这位瑞典国脚，她在五天后便完成了首秀，帮助球队在酋长球场与曼联的比赛中互交白卷并零封对手。
此后，斯米拉在代表阿森纳出场的29场比赛中攻入3球，其中包括今年9月对阵曼联时在补时阶段打入的戏剧性扳平进球。
身披31号战袍的她最初是以右后卫身份加盟，但在北伦敦的第一年里，她展现出了多面手属性，不仅在边后卫位置上表现出色，还能胜任中场和边锋。
如果斯米拉能够获奖，我们将成为自2022年该奖项设立以来，首个连续两年有球员获奖的俱乐部，此前米歇尔-阿杰曼在去年赢得了该奖项。
10位候选人分别为：
阿拉拉 - 拜仁慕尼黑，伊曼-贝内 - 曼城，费尔勒-布尔曼 - 切尔西，朱利亚-加利 - 巴塞罗那，阿祖拉-加洛 - 图卢兹，斯米拉-霍尔姆贝里 - 阿森纳，梅eline-门迪 - 巴黎FC，悉尼-谢尔滕莱布 - 巴塞罗那，费利西亚-施罗德 - 皇家马德里，克拉拉-塞拉霍尔迪 - 巴塞罗那
金女孩奖旨在表彰欧洲顶级联赛中最耀眼的年轻女足运动员，聚焦21岁以下的优秀球员。
自2022年创立以来，朱莉-布兰德、琳达-凯塞多以及三场欧冠冠军得主维奇-洛佩斯都曾赢得该奖项，随后阿杰曼在去年也将自己的名字刻入了这一荣耀名单。
斯米拉将力争成为第一位赢得金女孩奖的后卫。该奖项通常在11月初公布，随后通常会在12月举办盛典，同时庆祝金女孩和金男孩奖的得主。

items.titleEn: U18s preview: Arsenal v Tottenham Hotspur
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners are set for the first north London derby of the season
bodyEn: Our young Gunners will face Tottenham Hotspur in the first north London derby of the season on Saturday, October 17.
Kick-off at the Sobha Realty Training Centre is scheduled for 10.30am (UK time).
With four consecutive wins across all competitions and sitting in the top five of the U18 Premier League South, our academy side will face Spurs in red-hot form.
We climbed the table after thrashing Norwich City 5-1 in Norfolk, with Axel Donczew, Charlie Purdy and Emerson Nwaneri all finding the net, while Jaden Maghoma struck twice.
THE OPPOSITION
Our rivals sit top of the division after winning five of their opening six domestic games, with their only dropped points coming in a 2-2 draw away to Fulham last month.
Whilst still unbeaten, Tottenham have also scored 33 times in the competition, with their most recent result a 7-1 hammering of West Bromwich Albion.
The N17 outfit got the better of the Cottagers in the U18 Premier League Cup last weekend and currently lead Group G, having also beaten Derby County.
We last faced our NLD opponents in February, when we suffered a 4-1 home defeat, with Nwaneri’s second-half goal proving little more than a consolation.

bodyZh: 10月17日星期六，我们的年轻枪手将在本赛季的首场北伦敦德比中对阵托特纳姆热刺。
比赛将于英国时间上午10点30分在索布哈·雷亚尔蒂训练中心开球。
凭借各项赛事取得的四连胜以及在U18英超南部联赛积分榜前五的排名，我们的青训梯队将以火热的状态迎战热刺。
此前我们在诺福克以5-1大胜诺维奇后积分榜排名上升，阿克塞尔·东切夫（Axel Donczew）、查理·珀迪（Charlie Purdy）和埃默森·恩瓦内里（Emerson Nwaneri）均有斩获，贾登·马霍马（Jaden Maghoma）则梅开二度。
对手情况
我们的死敌在开局前六场国内比赛中赢下五场，目前暂居积分榜首位，他们唯一丢分的比赛是上个月客场2-2战平富勒姆。
热刺目前保持不败，在该赛事中已经打入33球，他们最近一场比赛以7-1大胜西布朗维奇。
这支来自N17的球队上周末在U18英超杯中击败了富勒姆，目前在击败德比郡后领跑G组。
我们上一次与北伦敦死敌交手是在2月，当时我们在主场1-4失利，恩瓦内里下半场的进球仅挽回了一点面子。

bodyEn: A lively reception awaits the former Liverpool midfielders Jordan Henderson and Xabi Alonso at Everton and, in the case of the former, any jeers can be considered an unintentional tribute. They will speak of what the 36-year-old is able to produce now as much as what, and where, he delivered in the past. With two goals and an assist against Bournemouth last Saturday, Henderson became the oldest player to contribute directly to three goals in a Premier League game, and demonstrated his role at Chelsea is not simply to elevate standards off the pitch. His midfield partnership with Moisés Caicedo gave Alonso’s team balance and enabled the front three of Morgan Rogers, João Pedro and Cole Palmer to flourish. Their confrontation against an Everton defence that had impressed this season, only to litter the draw at Hull with costly mistakes, will provide a stern test of the hosts’ unbeaten start and may well be dictated by the veteran behind them. Andy Hunter
Everton v Chelsea, Saturday 12.30pm (all times BST)

Still unbeaten in the top flight, Brentford are being served well by their commitment to pragmatism. Keith Andrews’ side like to sit deep, close off the middle of the pitch and force opponents to play around them, while flooding the opposition box at set pieces and throw-ins allows them to create the chances from which most of their goals arrive. In spanking six past Lask, the Austrian champions, Liverpool showed how good they can be on the front foot, but they will face far less obliging hosts at the Gtech Community Stadium. If Andoni Iraola’s side can dominate the ball and move it quickly enough to penetrate Brentford’s rearguard, they could win comfortably. However, the Bees’ efforts to turn the afternoon into a saloon brawl and capitalise on dead-ball situations may help to maintain their unbeaten run. Barry Glendenning
Brentford v Liverpool, Saturday 3pm

Gonzalo García has one league goal from 18 shots this season. The striker joined Fulham from Real Madrid in the summer and has looked promising in patches. García is 22 and capable of getting on the end of chances. He has an expected goals tally of 3.60 but is underperforming with his finishing. The challenge is to become more clinical. Fulham, bottom of the league, have six goals in six games and García is without a goal since scoring on his debut, against Chelsea. Álvaro Arbeloa has put a lot of faith in his fellow Spaniard. The head coach is under increasing pressure and winless Fulham need García to fire when they host Hull. Jacob Steinberg
Fulham v Hull, Saturday 3pm

Even when losing for the first time this season in Wednesday’s 4-2 Champions League defeat by Paris Saint-Germain, Manchester City appeared the real deal as they rallied from 3-0 down after 32 minutes to give the European champions a scare. Enzo Maresca deserves credit for following Pep Guardiola serenely; his City, so far, are a free-flowing attacking machine and invigorating to watch. If not for the guilty verdict against the club for serious financial breaches of Premier League rules, the perma-twinkling Italian might be more widely lauded. Ipswich last won at City in the competition in November 2000: do not expect the statistic to change on Saturday. Jamie Jackson
Manchester City v Ipswich, Saturday 3pm

Newcastle’s latest attempt to play vertical football left Matthias Jaissle’s side horizontal at Coventry on Monday night. That 4-1 defeat has prompted quite an inquest on Tyneside, where Jaissle could do without his players falling flat on their faces once more when Aston Villa visit St James’ Park. Jaissle maintains that his vertical football is the brand of high-octane, aggressive attacking that Newcastle’s hierarchy believes should become the club’s default, and is the way fans want to see the team play. That argument is not without validity but it is also worth remembering that, less than a decade ago, under Rafael Benítez’s charge, Newcastle often played a low block bolstered by three at the back, rarely took unnecessary risks and improved steadily. Admittedly resources were thinner then but the fans almost universally adored Benítez and were heartbroken when he eventually tired of Mike Ashley’s ownership and resigned. Quite apart from making his dislike for chaotic football plain, the Spaniard was a realist who knew a gung-ho approach would spell relegation. Granted, tactical fashions have changed, but Jaissle could do worse than slow things down a bit and search for his inner Rafa against Villa. Louise Taylor
Newcastle v Aston Villa, Saturday 5.30pm

With nine games each scheduled for the month between international breaks, Bournemouth v Sunderland will give an early indication of how both will cope during their first experience of such a relentless Thursday-Sunday autumnal grind. Sunderland are 17th, Bournemouth are 18th, and with seven points between them after six Premier League rounds, scaling similarly dizzy heights to last season already seems a lofty goal. For both clubs, European campaigns are far too much of an exciting novelty to be considered anything like a chore. In circumstances where squad depth is crucial, the returns of Justin Kluivert for the hosts and Brian Brobbey for the visitors will be welcomed by Marco Rose and Régis Le Bris. It would be no great surprise to see either Dutch international make a game-deciding contribution in what is already a six-pointer on the south coast. BG

Bournemouth v Sunderland, Sunday 2pm

Brighton’s momentum appears unstoppable at the moment, although supporters will be wary of Sunday’s showdown against Crystal Palace given their recent history. They haven’t beaten Palace since a 4-1 thrashing at the Amex in February 2024, when Roberto De Zerbi was in charge, while Fabian Hürzeler managed only a point in four encounters with the Eagles under Oliver Glasner. Both are having to juggle European commitments this season and Brighton will start as heavy favourites against Pierre Sage’s side after their superb start to the campaign. Palace have big concerns in defence, but can the Frenchman defy the odds against the Premier League’s top scorers? Ed Aarons
Brighton v Crystal Palace, Sunday 2pm

Michael Carrick has lost five of his past six technical-area duels with Daniel Farke. Indeed the only time Manchester United’s manager has bested his Leeds counterpart was in a League Cup tie during his Middlesbrough tenure. If such statistics are not sufficient to put Manchester United’s currently beleaguered manager off a trip to West Yorkshire on Sunday, there is a sense that Leeds are overdue a first victory at Elland Road since 2002 against their arch-enemies from across the Pennines. One thing is certain; it will be a typically raucous latter-day War of the Roses. But, right now, while the White Rose blooms, its red counterpart is wilting alarmingly. Will Carrick survive this latest meeting with a manager who, at Championship level during his Middlesbrough days, proved something of a nemesis? He will not care to remember that last January a 1-1 draw at Elland Road proved to be Ruben Amorim’s final game in charge of Manchester United. LT
Leeds v Manchester United, Sunday 2pm

Despite losing 3-1 to Crystal Palace last weekend, Nottingham Forest played some excellent front-foot football only to be let down by extreme profligacy in front of goal and vulnerability to their hosts’ counterattacks. Oliver Glasner attributed his side’s defeat to karma upon his return to Palace, saying: “It was like I didn’t deserve to win at Selhurst Park, because the players did everything.” When they welcome Arsenal to the City Ground on Sunday they will give the champions plenty to ponder if they can play as well again. Mikel Arteta’s side were unconvincing for 65 minutes against Leeds last weekend and failed to impress until they brought on their heavy artillery about the same time against Lille on Tuesday. If one or both of Morgan Gibbs-White and Liam Delap can convert the kind of chances they missed at Selhurst Park, Forest have every chance of getting something. BG
Nottingham Forest v Arsenal, Sunday 4.30pm

The last time Tottenham hosted Coventry in the Premier League, Steffen Iversen, Les Ferdinand and Serhiy Rebrov scored in a comfortable 3-0 win. And while Spurs fans will almost certainly have envisaged a similar scoreline when the fixtures were announced, they will now be viewing Monday night’s fixture with even more than the usual amount of apprehension and dread. Like Tottenham, Coventry’s main problem until recently was an inability to convert chances, but in their demolition of Newcastle on Monday they visibly grew in confidence and swagger as four different players took the plaudits. While it’s taken a while and they may still struggle, through back-to-back wins Frank Lampard’s side have now announced themselves as a Premier League force to be reckoned with, which is something Tottenham haven’t managed in more than two years. BG
Tottenham v Coventry, Monday 8pm

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳周末将客场挑战诺丁汉森林，本轮英超迎来多场焦点对决。
bodyZh: 前利物浦中场球员乔丹·亨德森和哈维·阿隆索将在埃弗顿迎来热烈的欢迎，对于前者而言，任何嘘声都可以被视为一种无意的致敬。人们将谈论这位36岁的球员现在能够贡献什么，就像过去他在哪里以及贡献了什么一样。上周六对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，亨德森贡献了两射一传，成为英超历史上单场直接参与三球年龄最大的球员，这也证明了他在切尔西的作用不仅仅是提升场外标准。他和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的中场搭档为阿隆索的球队带来了平衡，并让摩根·罗杰斯、若昂·佩德罗和科尔·帕尔默组成的前场三叉戟得以大显身手。他们与埃弗顿防线的对决将是对主队不败金身的严峻考验。
埃弗顿对阵切尔西，周六中午12:30（英国夏令时，下同）

布伦特福德在顶级联赛中依然保持不败，其实用主义的战术风格为他们带来了丰厚回报。基斯·安德鲁斯的球队喜欢沉退防守，封锁中路并迫使对手从外围进攻，同时在定位球和界外球时大举压入对方禁区，这让他们创造了大部分进球的机会。在以6比0大胜奥地利冠军LASK时，利物浦展现了他们积极进攻时的出色状态，但他们在格技社区球场将面对防守更为顽强的主队。如果对手能够控球并以足够快的速度撕破布伦特福德的防线，他们或许能轻松取胜。然而，主队试图将比赛变成一场混战并利用死球局面的努力，或许能帮助他们延续不败纪录。
布伦特福德对阵利物浦，周六下午3点

贡萨洛·加西亚本赛季在联赛中18次射门只打进1球。这位前锋在夏天从皇家马德里加盟富勒姆，在比赛的某些时段表现出了潜力。加西亚现年22岁，具备捕捉机会的能力。他的预期进球数达到了3.60，但他的终结效率不佳。摆在他面前的挑战是提高门前把握机会的能力。目前排名联赛垫底的富勒姆在6场比赛中攻入6球，加西亚自从在对阵切尔西的处子秀中破门以来就一直未能进球。阿尔瓦罗·阿尔韦拉罗对这位同胞给予了极大的信任。这位主教练正面临越来越大的压力，未尝胜绩的富勒姆在主场迎战赫尔城时亟需加西亚挺身而出。
富勒姆对阵赫尔城，周六下午3点

即使在周三以2比4输给巴黎圣日耳曼遭遇本赛季首场失利时，曼城在开场32分钟内从0比3落后奋起直追，给欧冠冠军制造了不小的麻烦，依然展现出了真正的实力。恩佐·马雷斯卡平静地追随瓜佩普·瓜迪奥拉的表现理应受到赞赏；到目前为止，他的曼城是一台流畅的进攻机器，令人赏心悦目。如果不是因为该俱乐部因严重违反英超财务规则而被判有罪，这位闪耀的意大利人可能会受到更广泛的赞誉。伊普斯维奇上一次在该赛事中客胜曼城还要追溯到2000年11月：不要指望周六这一统计数据会发生改变。
曼城对阵伊普斯维奇，周六下午3点

纽卡斯尔联队尝试纵向足球的最新尝试，导致马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒的球队周一晚上在考文垂被打得横着离开。那场1比4的失利在泰恩赛德引发了一场大清查，贾伊斯勒最不希望看到的就是当阿斯顿维拉造访圣詹姆斯公园时，他的球员再次一败涂地。贾伊斯勒坚信，他的纵向足球正是纽卡斯尔高层认为应该成为俱乐部默认风格、且球迷们希望看到的充满激情、极具侵略性的进攻品牌。这一论点并非没有道理，但也值得记住的是，不到十年前在拉法·贝尼特斯的带领下，纽卡斯尔经常采用三中卫的低位防守，极少冒不必要的风险并稳步提升。不可否认当时资源较为单薄，但球迷几乎普遍喜爱贝尼特斯，并在他最终厌倦迈克·阿什利的所有权而辞职时心碎。撇开他对混乱足球的不满不谈，这位西班牙人是一个现实主义者，深知大举压上的战术会导致降级。当然，战术风向已经改变，但贾伊斯勒与其盲目激进，倒不如在对阵维拉时放慢节奏，寻找内心的拉法。
纽卡斯尔对阵阿斯顿维拉，周六下午5点30分

由于国际比赛日之间的一个月内各自有九场比赛要踢，伯恩茅斯对阵桑德兰的比赛将为双方如何应对首次经历这种无情的周四-周日秋季魔鬼赛程提供早期迹象。桑德兰排名第17位，伯恩茅斯排名第18位，在经过六轮英超联赛后，两队积分相差7分，想要达到上赛季那样令人眩晕的高度似乎已经是一个高不可攀的目标。对于这两家俱乐部而言，欧战征程远非一件令人兴奋的新鲜事，更谈不上是什么苦差事。在阵容深度至关重要的情况下，主队的贾斯廷·克鲁伊维特和客队的布赖恩·布罗贝的回归将受到马尔科·罗斯和雷吉斯·勒布里的欢迎。在这场南海岸的价值六分的关键战中，看到任何一位荷兰国脚做出决定比赛的贡献都不会令人感到意外。

在时事通讯推广之后
伯恩茅斯对阵桑德兰，周日下午2点

布莱顿目前的势头似乎势不可挡，但考虑到最近的历史，球迷们会对周日对阵水晶宫的对决保持警惕。自从罗伯托·德泽尔比执教期间在2024年2月的运河球场以4比1大胜以来，他们就没有赢过水晶宫，而法比安·许策勒在奥利弗·格拉斯纳手下四次对阵老鹰队也只拿到了一场平局。本赛季两支球队都必须兼顾欧战任务，凭借出色的开局，布莱顿在迎战皮埃尔·萨奇的球队时将占据绝对优势。水晶宫的防线存在巨大隐患，但这位法国主帅能否在英超顶级火力面前创造奇迹？
布莱顿对阵水晶宫，周日下午2点

迈克尔·卡里克在教练席上最近六次与丹尼尔·法尔克的较量中输掉了五场。事实上，这位曼联主教练唯一一次击败他的老对手还是在米德尔斯堡执教期间的一场联赛杯比赛中。如果这些数据还不足以打消曼联目前这位饱受困扰的主教练在周日前往西约克郡的念头的话，人们有一种感觉，利兹联对阵自2002年以来首次在埃兰路球场战胜他们来自奔宁山脉另一侧的老死对头已经逾期太久。有一点是确定的；这将是一场具有现代典型喧嚣色彩的玫瑰战争。但目前，当白玫瑰盛开时，红玫瑰却在惊人地枯萎。卡里克能否在这场与一位在米德尔斯堡时期曾堪称其苦主的教练的再度交锋中生还？他一定不愿想起去年1月在埃兰路球场的那场1比1平局，正是鲁本·阿莫林执教曼联的最后一场比赛。
利兹联对阵曼联，周日下午2点

尽管上周末1比3不敌水晶宫，但诺丁汉森林踢出了一些非常出色的前场进攻，只是在门前极度挥霍机会以及防范对手反击时的脆弱让他们付出了代价。奥利弗·格拉斯纳在重返塞尔赫斯特公园球场时将球队的失利归咎于因果报应，他说道：“感觉我不配在塞尔赫斯特公园赢球，因为球员们付出了一切。”当他们在周日迎来阿森纳的造访时，如果他们能再次踢出如此出色的表现，将给卫冕冠军带来足够多的思考。米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在上周末对阵利兹联时表现得缺乏说服力，直到周二差不多同一时间换上重兵后才在对阵里尔时让人眼前一亮。如果摩根·吉布斯-怀特和利亚姆·德拉普两人中有一人或全部人能够将他们在塞尔赫斯特公园错失的机会转化为进球，森林队完全有机会取得积分。
诺丁汉森林对阵阿森纳，周日下午4点30分

托特纳姆热刺上一次在英超主场迎战考文垂时，斯特芬·埃弗森、莱斯·费迪南德和谢尔盖·雷布罗夫各进一球，取得了一场3比0的轻松胜利。虽然当赛程公布时，热刺球迷几乎肯定会设想过类似的比分，但他们现在带着比以往更多的忧虑和恐惧来看待周一晚上的这场比赛。和热刺一样，考文垂直到最近的主要问题也是无法将机会转化为进球，但在周一击败纽卡斯尔的比赛中，随着四名不同的球员建功，他们的信心和气势明显增强。虽然这花了一些时间，他们可能仍在挣扎，但通过连胜，弗兰克·兰帕德的球队现在已经宣告自己是一支不容小觑的英超力量，这是热刺在两年多时间里都未能做到的事情。
托特纳姆热刺对阵考文垂，周一晚上8点

items.titleEn: Every word from Renée's pre-Birmingham presser
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers has given her thoughts ahead of taking on Birmingham in the Women's Super League on Saturday, October 17
bodyEn: Renée Slegers has been speaking to the press ahead of our home match against Birmingham City in the Women's Super League.
Marking two years since she initially became interim boss, Renée gave team news, assessed the newly promoted side and much more at the Sobha Realty Training Centre.
Here's everything she said:

on how things have been during the international break:It's been good. We've had some players here training on the pitch, so that's been good, quality time with them. The weekend off for the players that were here, for staff that was here, so that was good to get a reset. I think all staff and players have been spending time with their family and friends, so that's been really good, and of course, I've been watching all the games, all the football that's been played and our players' performances, which have been really positive. There's been a lot of goals, so that's been really pleasing to see. Today was the first day back in with everyone and there was great energy, so it was nice to see everyone again.

on Russo and Stanway scoring for England:That was really nice to see, and there were some other players in the squad with goals as well, quite some. I think there were a total of 13 goals scored by our players over the break, so that was really positive. Good for us, and I think for everyone, nice to have a change of environment. If I see how everyone comes back, my mindset, going back into games now and seeing everyone else, I think very driven and very determined. I think we want to be there on Saturday, reconnecting with the fans and bringing our absolute best, play with urgency and play our absolute best football, like I just said. We look forward to that, but I think the break has been good. Now we go into a block of six weeks and nine games, which we look forward to.

on team news for Birmingham:Mariona went off against City, didn't go away with Spain, hamstring injury, so she will be out for a while. Selina Cerci had surgery on her knee, she had been struggling and it got worse, so we had to intervene unfortunately. So she's out as well for a while.

on what to expect from Birmingham:They're a hard-working team. They have some individual qualities. They're fast on the break, like many teams do well this year in the league, they're one of them. Like I said, there are some individual qualities centrally and on the wings that we really have to minimise and stop. So I see them looking for that and that's how they've been successful and scored a couple of goals. So we'll really have to stop that, but on the other side, we see the opportunity of course. We had two days, we just did a session on pitch and we'll have a session tomorrow to build back in on how we want to do things and the connection on the pitch. So we absolutely see the opportunities and that there will be spaces and areas that we want to attack. But yes, they haven't maybe gotten the three-pointers, Birmingham, but as you said, they have been threatening teams. So we'll definitely want to stop that.

on her message to the team:So for today, and for the next game, it's a strengths-based approach: What have we done well? What are we good at as a group? and laser focus on the game plan Birmingham for now, and then next week we'll go more into detail of the work-ons, the little tweaks. So that's been the message to the group. So it has been very light today, positive, and like I said, next week will be more detail going forward.

on how long Mariona will be out for:Yeah, so it's a bigger hamstring injury, and the estimate right now is between 8-10 weeks, but we'll see. We're re-scanning and we did a re-scan this week and the healing process looks good. So of course we're hoping for less, but yeah, it's a bigger hamstring injury.

on Cerci missing part of pre-season having an impact on her season:Yeah, that's one of the reasons. That's why it was harder to build back into the team with missing parts of pre-season for her. She has been available. She has trained the majority of training sessions with the team. But of course, it's a factor and it affects the player when you are managing something and you have pain somewhere. I think most of these athletes play with some sort of pain or some sort of niggle. But yeah, it became too much, and with Germany, they did a scan and the best solution going forward was to clean it up.

on the make-up of the midfield without Mariona:Yeah, of course, we're gutted to lose Mariona. She's so good for us. She's been so good for us for a long time and gutted for her as well because she loves the game. She loves to play. Our midfield unit is important for us. It's the spine of the team and connects everything on the pitch. Both when we attack and defend, so it is an important unit and some things have changed. Of course, Kyra is back with us, Georgia is with us now, and now, losing Mariona, we'll have to find the right solutions, play the players to their strengths, and find the right balance in the middle of the pitch. So that's what we're looking to do going forward into this block.

on Reuteler's involvement so far:So if I take you with us all the way from the start of preseason to where we are now, she was also one of the players that had to do a little intervention to get back fit again. So she missed some weeks in pre-season, and then with the big change in squad, we were balancing getting the new players onto the pitch, but still finding some sort of consistency, and I think with the difficulty of results and the difficulty that we've had as a team, it's been also hard for some players, and then I'm honest to say I've told a couple of players individually as well, some players earned more rewards as well for the way they've trained and the qualities that they can bring to the team. But in some moments we chose other things, consistency being one of them. Geraldine is looking good. She's training well. It's a long season. So there's definitely a really positive perspective for her, and when she plays for us, we want to play to her strengths. I think she's really good when she gets the freedom to make deep runs and affect the game in the final third with her directness, she's good in and around the box and she's a really intense player, can cover ground. So it's looking positive, even though I understand from the outside, the question is asked. But on the inside, we're seeing progress and it's part of the process.

on if she listens to outside noise:For me individually, no. But if I look at my heavy internal focus, that’s what matters to me the most. Is the belief there, is the energy there, are we aligned, that’s what matters to me. That would put pressure on myself, but for example when I see the fans after the game, that’s different because they’re so close to us. We know what the fans invest - they spend their money, time and weekends coming to see us - so that matters to me, but further than that, I appreciate the work you guys are doing for the game and it’s part of your job, however that’s not what I’m focusing on.

on Olivia Smith's minutes this season:Olivia is a player who has such a high ceiling, and she’s amazing. She’s the best I’ve seen in a couple of things she can do - I haven’t really seen it before - she’s a player we brought to Arsenal and believe in extremely. I know the impact she can make for us. Also with Olivia, she has been dealing with some issues that we’ve had to manage in the background, but she’s pain-free now. You saw when she played for Canada, I was so pleased to see, she looked free and did everything she’s good at. She takes on players on the dribble, is good in tight spaces, gets shots off from the edge with her right and left foot. I’m so happy she’s back to her best, we’ve seen that, and I just had a conversation this morning as well that I look forward to the impact she can make. It’s looking positive when it comes to Liv.

on the advice she'd give to her 2024 self:A lot has happened since then, and there are a couple of things. If I sit here now and look back at the two years, there’s one thing we know and that’s things are constantly changing. How do you anticipate and make change, and that’s a big one for me that I’ve learned. I’ve taken so much from it and it’s made me better as a person as well, and certainly in a short period of time, a lot has happened and changed.

on the impact of Mariona in the team:Mariona is a real team player, and does all the roles and responsibilities whether she plays in the six, eight, ten or the last couple of games on the left. But of course, with specific qualities. It’s a loss for us not to have Mariona and I’m gutted for her as well because of the love for the game she has. If she had the choice, she’d always be on the pitch, but we have to deal with it and we have quality players. Like I said, things constantly change and this is also part of our role to then find the right balance. We have a lot of quality in our midfield and we have to make those decisions.

on Georgia Stanway's best position:I think it depends on when you stop the picture to see whether someone is in or out of position. What we’ve seen with Georgia is that she’s really good in and around the box and in between the lines. She’s done that role for England and for us, she’s really good for England in that role too. Whether on the teamsheet she starts in another system with number seven on her shirt, she ends up in the same area. But yeah, play players to their strengths, and we need good balance in the team for Birmingham as well because they break fast, they have quality, they have individuals that can do something by themselves. We go into the game with a lot of belief in ourselves and hopefully a lot of time spent in the final third.

on the outcome of the review conducted over the international break:That might have sounded bigger than it was, because we do reviews after every international window. We look at all aspects, all areas, and the things we’ve looked at this window are football from a data and subjective perspective - what do we do well, the growth areas, our training program, our culture, and that’s part of a process we do every window. There are some really good small outcomes from the reviews where we want to put our focus, but that’s all part of the process.

on what she’d like to implement going forward:It’s things in the way we play, where we focus. It’s things in the way we train, small things that we think can have a big impact for us, those are the main ones. Then at the same time, as I said, strengths-based approach: everything we’re good at, continue to do it so we also have some form of consistency in the basics in everything we do. So yeah, there’s a lot of clarity coming out of this window and I really look forward to starting to apply it in this next block.

on her commitment to Arsenal:Of course, yeah, I love Arsenal, I love this team, I wouldn’t want to be anywhere else. Even though it’s been difficult, I see light at the end of the tunnel and I look forward. I feel that we are strong together and I look forward to Saturday.

on what gives her belief that positive results are coming:It’s in everything. Like I said, I have a strong focus on what we do here internally, the people here, sensitive to energies, find it important that we’re aligned, leaders within the staff, leaders within the playing group, everyone on the boat going in the same direction, and I see a lot of perspective. I acknowledge the results are we’re not happy with the results, but then there’s a lot of positives as well in the way we play. The commitment in the background and the determination in the background has been inspiring, I think, for all of us. So everyone’s come back now. You can see it, you can feel it, there’s a sense of urgency and we look forward from here.

on if the players are reinvigorated after the international break:We’ve only spent a couple of hours so far, but it’s really chatty and bubbly in the restaurant, in the meeting room too. Training pitch intensity was sharp, even though for a lot of players we’re on a matchday plus two, so we had to manage the session, but everyone looked sharp, present, focused and just lots of connections and energy that I could feel today, so it was really positive.
on if Chloe Kelly is available:She’s not available.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅勒妮赛前谈球队伤病与对阵伯明翰的备战情况。
bodyZh: 勒妮-斯勒格斯出席了英超联赛对阵伯明翰城主场比赛前的赛前新闻发布会。
在索布哈地产训练中心，正值她最初出任临时主帅两周年之际，勒妮介绍了球队伤病情况，评估了这支升班马对手，并谈到了诸多其他话题。
以下是她的全部发言：

关于国际比赛日期间的情况：情况很好。我们有一些球员留在这里在球场上训练，所以这是一段与她们在一起很好的高质量时间。留在这里的球员和工作人员在周末放假了，所以进行重置感觉很好。我认为所有工作人员和球员都花时间与家人和朋友在一起了，这真的很好，当然，我一直在观看所有的比赛，所有进行的比赛以及我们球员的表现，这些都非常积极。有很多进球，所以看到这些真的很令人高兴。今天是大家归队的第一天，能量满满，所以很高兴再次见到大家。

关于鲁索和斯坦韦为英格兰队进球：看到这一幕真的很棒，阵容中还有其他一些球员也取得了进球，相当不少。我想我们在间歇期期间我们的球员总共打入了13粒进球，这非常积极。这对我们很好，我认为对每个人来说，换个环境也是件好事。如果我看到每个人归队时的状态、我的心态，以及重返比赛并看到其他所有人时的状态，我认为大家都非常有动力，也非常坚定。我认为我们希望在周六出现在那里，与球迷重新建立联系，展现出我们绝对最佳的状态，带着紧迫感踢球，就像我刚才说的，踢出我们绝对最好的足球。我们对此充满期待，但我认为这个间歇期过得很不错。接下来我们要迎来一个为期六周、包含九场比赛的赛程，我们对此充满期待。
关于对阵伯明翰的球队伤病情况：马里奥娜在对阵曼城的比赛中离场，没有随西班牙队出征，她遭遇了腿筋受伤，因此将缺阵一段时间。塞利娜-切尔奇接受了膝盖手术，她之前一直在与伤病作斗争而且情况恶化了，所以不幸的是我们不得不进行干预。因此她也将缺阵一段时间。

关于对伯明翰的预期：他们是一支努力工作的球队。他们拥有一些个人能力。他们在反击中速度很快，就像今年联赛中许多球队做得很好的那样，他们就是其中之一。就像我说的，他们在组织核心位置和边路有一些我们需要极力限制和遏制的个人能力。所以我看到他们在寻找这样的机会，这就是他们取得成功并打入几个球的方式。所以我们真的必须阻止这一点，但另一方面，我们当然也看到了机会。我们有两天时间，刚刚在球场上进行了一堂训练课，我们明天还有一堂训练课，以重新适应我们想要做的事情以及球场上的联系。所以我们绝对看到了机会，并且会有我们想要攻击的空间和区域。但是的，伯明翰可能还没有拿到三分，但正如你所说，他们一直在给对手制造威胁。所以我们肯定想要阻止这一点。
关于给全队的信息：因此对于今天以及下一场比赛，这是一个基于优势的方法：我们什么做得好？作为集体我们擅长什么？目前要像激光一样专注于伯明翰的比赛计划，然后下周我们将更详细地讨论需要改进的地方和小调整。这就是传达给团队的信息。所以今天的气氛非常轻松、积极，就像我说的，下周会有更多细节上的推进。
关于马里奥娜将缺阵多久：是的，这是一个比较严重的腿筋受伤，目前的估计是在8到10周之间，但我们会看情况。我们正在重新进行扫描，本周我们做了一次复查，愈合过程看起来不错。所以我们当然希望时间能更短一些，但是的，这是一个比较严重的腿筋损伤。
关于切尔奇错过部分季前赛对其赛季的影响：是的，这是原因之一。这也是为什么对她来说，错过部分季前赛后更难重新融入球队的原因。她一直是可以出场的。她随队参加了大部分训练课。但当然，这是一个因素，当你正在处理一些问题且某处感到疼痛时，会对球员产生影响。我认为大多数这些运动员都是带着某种疼痛或某种小伤在踢球。但是的，情况变得有点严重了，在德国队他们做了一次扫描，最好的解决方案就是进行清理。

关于没有马里奥娜时的中场组合：是的，当然，失去马里奥娜让我们感到痛心。她对我们太重要了。长期以来她对我们一直都非常好，而且对她本人来说也很痛心，因为她热爱这项运动。她热爱踢球。我们的中场组合对我们很重要。它是球队的脊椎，连接着球场上的一切。无论是进攻还是防守，所以这是一个重要的组合，有些事情发生了变化。当然，凯拉回到了我们身边，乔治亚现在也和我们在一起，现在失去了马里奥娜，我们将不得不找到正确的解决方案，发挥球员的长处，并在中场找到正确的平衡。这就是我们接下来在这个赛程区块中所要做的。

关于雷特勒到目前为止的参与情况：如果我带你从季前赛开始一直回顾到我们现在的处境，她也是那些不得不进行小干预以恢复健康的球员之一。所以她在季前赛中错过了几周，然后随着阵容的巨大变化，我们在让新球员上场与保持某种稳定性之间进行平衡，而且我认为由于成绩的困难以及我们作为一个团队所经历的困难，对一些球员来说也很艰难，我很坦诚地说，我也曾单独对个别球员说过，一些球员凭借她们的训练方式和她们能为球队带来的品质，本应赢得更多的回报。但在某些时刻我们选择了其他事情，稳定性就是其中之一。杰拉丁看起来状态不错。她训练得很好。这是一个漫长的赛季。所以对她来说绝对有一个非常积极的前景，当她为我们出场时，我们希望发挥她的特长。我认为当她获得自由进行前插并在进攻三区通过直接的踢法对比赛产生影响时，她真的非常优秀，她在禁区内和周围表现很好，她是一名非常有拼劲的球员，能够覆盖很大的面积。所以情况看起来是积极的，尽管我理解从外部来看会有人问这个问题。但在内部，我们看到了进步，这是过程的一部分。

关于她是否听取外部噪音：对我个人而言，不会。但如果我看看我高度集中的内部关注点，那才是我最关心的。信念是否在那里，能量是否在那里，我们是否步调一致，这才是对我有意义的。这会给自己带来压力，但例如当我在赛后看到球迷时，那是不同的，因为他们离我们太近了。我们知道球迷们投入了什么——他们花钱、花时间和周末来看我们比赛——所以这对我有意义，除此之外，我很感激你们为这项运动所做的工作，这是你们工作的一部分，然而这并不是我关注的焦点。

关于奥利维亚-史密斯本赛季的出场时间：奥利维亚是一位上限极高且令人惊叹的球员。在某些她能做的事情上，她是我见过最好的——我以前真的没怎么见过——我们把她带到阿森纳并且对她极其信任。我知道她能为我们带来怎样的影响。同样对于奥利维亚来说，她一直在处理一些我们需要在后台进行管理的问题，但她现在已经没有痛楚了。当你看到她为加拿大队效力时，我很高兴看到她看起来很自由，并且做了所有她擅长的事情。她通过盘带过人，在狭小空间内表现出色，并用左右脚在禁区边缘起脚射门。我很高兴她恢复了最佳状态，我们已经看到了这一点，我今天早上也刚刚进行过交谈，我期待着她能带来的影响。在利v（奥利维亚）的问题上，情况看起来很积极。
关于她会对2024年的自己给出什么建议：从那时起发生了很多事情，有几件事。如果我现在坐在这里回顾这两年，有一件事是我们知道的，那就是事情在不断变化。你如何预测并做出改变，这对我来说是一个很大的学习。我从中汲取了太多，这也让我作为一个更好的人，当然在很短时间内，发生了很多事情和变化。

关于马里奥娜在球队中的影响：马里奥娜是一个真正的团队球员，无论她踢6号位、8号位、10号位还是最近几场比赛踢左路，她都承担着所有的角色和职责。但当然，带有她特定的品质。没有马里奥娜对我们来说是一个损失，而且因为她对比赛的热爱，我也为她感到难过。如果她有选择，她总是想留在球场上，但我们必须应对，我们有高品质的球员。就像我说的，事情在不断变化，找到正确的平衡也是我们职责的一部分。我们中场有很多优秀的球员，我们必须做出这些决定。

关于乔治亚-斯坦韦的最佳位置：我认为这取决于你在什么时候定格画面来看某人是否处于位置上。我们对乔治亚的看法是，她在禁区内及周围以及线与线之间真的非常出色。她为英格兰队和我们都踢过那个角色，她在英格兰队的那个角色上也表现得非常好。无论在首发名单上她是否以球衣号码7号在另一个系统中开始，她最终都会出现在同一个区域。但是的，要发挥球员的特长，我们在对阵伯明翰时也需要在球队中保持良好的平衡，因为他们反击速度快，他们有实力，他们有能够凭一己之力改变局面的个人。我们带着对自己的极大信念进入比赛，并希望在进攻三区花费大量时间。
关于国际比赛日期间进行的复审结果：听起来可能比实际情况更大，因为我们在每个国际比赛窗口结束后都会进行复审。我们会审视所有方面、所有领域，我们在本窗口审视的事项是从数据和主观角度来看待足球——我们什么做得好，需要增长的领域，我们的训练计划，我们的文化，这是我们每个窗口都在进行的流程的一部分。复审产生了一些非常好的、我们想要集中精力的微小成果，但这都是过程的一部分。
关于她未来想要贯彻的东西：这是关于我们踢球方式中我们关注的事情。这是关于我们训练方式的事情，我们认为可以产生巨大影响的小事情，这些是主要的。同时，正如我所说，采用基于优势的方法：我们擅长的所有事情，继续去做，这样我们在所做的一切的基础中也有某种形式的稳定性。所以是的，这个窗口带来了很多清晰度，我非常期待在接下来的这个阶段开始应用它。
关于她对阿森纳的承诺：当然，是的，我爱阿森纳，我爱这支球队，我不想去其他任何地方。尽管这一路很艰难，但我看到了隧道的尽头有光芒，我充满期待。我觉得我们团结一致，我期待着周六的到来。

关于是什么让她相信积极的成果即将到来：这一切都在于方方面面。就像我说的，我高度关注我们在这里内部所做的事情，这里的人，对能量敏感，认为我们步调一致很重要，员工中的领导者，球员群体中的领导者，每个人都在同一条船上朝着同一个方向前进，我看到了很多远景。我承认我们对结果不满意，但我们在踢球的方式中也有很多积极的因素。我认为，后台的承诺和后台的决心对我们所有人来说都是一种激励。所以现在每个人都回来了。你能看到它，你能感受到它，有一种紧迫感，我们从这里开始充满期待。
关于球员们在国际比赛日后是否恢复了活力：我们到现在只花了几个小时，但在餐厅里、在会议室里都聊得很开心，气氛很活跃。训练场的强度很犀利，尽管对很多球员来说今天是比赛日后第二天，所以我们必须控制训练课，但每个人看起来都很犀利、在状态、专注，今天我能感受到很多联系和能量，所以这真的很积极。
关于克洛伊-凯利是否可以出场：她无法出场。

items.titleEn: Arsenal 3-0 Lille: Champions League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Arsenal toiled for an hour before tearing Lille apart three times in eight second-half minutes 1 min: Peeeeeep!Right then. Hands shaken, coin tossed, pennants exchanged, huddles broken. It’s time. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Right, that’s all from me. Bye! Before I go, here’s Ed Aarons’ match report again:
And by way of parting gift here’s Sid Lowe on Manchester United’s defeat at Atletico Madrid:
Eberiche Eze sums the match up:

double quotation markGood performance. We done what we needed to do, played free and enjoyed it, which is the main thing. A lot of teams come here with a lot of energy so the first half can be quite difficult, but the aim is to grind teams down.
Ed Aarons’ match report has landed!

Twelve wins in a row and counting. On a night when Arsenal remembered Ken Friar – the club’s life president who was instrumental in their move from Highbury to the Emirates in 2006 – it was fitting that Mikel ­Arteta’s side should rack up yet another Champions League milestone at their home that has become a fortress.

Such has Arsenal’s dominance been here in recent seasons that when Bukayo Saka slotted home their third against a dogged Lille side, it was the 36th goal they have scored at the Emirates in the league or group stage since returning to Europe’s top table under Arteta three years ago.
Much more here:
While we wait for our match report, here’s one on England’s 5-0 trouncing of Greece in their women’s World Cup play-off:
Tonight’s Champions League scores in full:

Arsenal 3-0 Lille Atletico Madrid 2-0 Manchester United Galatasaray 1-4 Barcelona Internazionale 3-4 Club Brugge Lens 0-2 Sporting RB Leipzig 1-0 PSV Sabah 2-0 Slavia Prague Viking 3-3 Bayern Munich* Villarreal 3-1 Napoli
* Drama here: Viking 2-0 up at half-time, 2-3 down when Michael Olise was sent off for a second yellow card in the 73rd minute, and they snatched a last-minute equaliser.
Jurrien Timber, whose goal cracked Lille open, has a chat:

double quotation markI had some moments in the first half. The first touch was good, which was half of the job. Then Noni was screaming “Shoot! Shoot! Shoot!”, so I shot. I wasn’t thinking too much. I was just thinking, “I need to shoot”. We needed that first goal. We were playing well but we needed that goal. We know how good we are. First half we had some moments, we were sloppy, but we were always in control. We just need to keep going. It’s still early in the season.

90+4 mins: It’s all over! Three goals in eight minutes carry Arsenal to victory over an impressively organised but ultimately outclassed Lille, who simply couldn’t give the ball away as frequently as they did in the second half and get away with it.
90+2 mins: Havertz closes down the keeper a little overenthusiastically, catches him as he follows through having made his clearance, and is booked.
90+1 mins: Into stoppage time, of which there’ll be three minutes or so.
90 mins: A lovely first-time pass from Odegaard to Dowman, inside a congested penalty area. Doesn’t come to anything, but absolutely great all the same.
88 mins: Manchester United, meanwhile, are two goals and a man down in Madrid.
85 mins: Arsenal bring Max Dowman on for Eze.
84 mins: Arsenal playing at walking pace, which they were pretty much doing for much of the first hour but which feels much less aggravating now.
82 mins: Lille bring Soriba Diaoune on for Bakwa.
81 mins: Goffi gets booked for fouling Eze, not a good challenge at all, but not quite bad enough for anything more severe.
78 mins: Olivier Giroud gets the fourth-loudest cheer of the night so far as he comes on for Ueda. Calvin Verdonk also comes on, for Perraud, and Arsenal bring Ben White on for Timber.

77 mins: Lille give the ball away again, about 40 yards from their goal, and Arsenal have four against two and really should score. But Guimaraes has no interest in passing it, and instead takes a shot from 25 yards that Ozer saves.
77 mins: Olivier Giroud is, apparently, about to get his moment.
76 mins: Not having Gyokeres on the pitch makes such a big difference for Arsenal.
73 mins: Almost a chance for Lille! Rice thinks he’s been fouled but the referee waves play on, the ball is played infield from the right to Bakwa, and Konsa throws himself in the way of his shot.
73 mins: Lille take off Bentaleb and Mukau, and bring on Sahraoui and Kjaergaard.

I’m old enough to remember when this game felt close. The three substitutes combine for this one: Odegaard releases Havertz down the right side of the penalty area, he cuts back to Saka, and Saka sidefoots across goal and in at the far post!
70 mins: Save! Arsenal are now all but unstoppable. Saka’s cross from the right almost falls to Rice, and a few seconds later Eze is played in to the left of goal, but Ozer gets a hand to his shot.

Arsenal double their lead, and this goal is all the sweeter for coming from the ball being gifted to them by the former Spurs midfielder Nabil Bentaleb. It’s played down the right to Saka, whose first touch is to pass into the middle, where Eze’s shot deflects (I think) past Ozer.
65 mins: Arsenal make their triple substitution, with Madueke, Merino and Gyokeres going off for Saka, Odegaard and Havertz.
65 mins: Madueke plays the ball into Timber, inside the penalty area but with his back to goal, whose first touch takes him past Andre, and whose second dinks it over Ozer. That really is very good.
Arsenal take the lead thanks to a lovely piece of work from Jurrien Timber!
63 mins: Lille haven’t got out of their half since the break. They’ve been appalling in possession, but still defensively and organisationally excellent.
62 mins: Arteta has seen enough, and is readying Havertz, Saka and Odegaard for an imminent triple change.
61 mins: Guimaraes attempts a 360-degree penalty-area pirouette. Sure, he loses the ball, but those dancing feet!
60 mins: Guimaraes runs into the area and goes down, and this time Arsenal are interested. But the referee is not, and neither is VAR.
59 mins: Lille take too long over a defensive throw-in, and it gets handed to Arsenal. But again, nothing comes of it.
57 mins: It may be time for Arsenal to utilise their bench – the only thing that’s really changed since half-time is the amount of grumbling coming from the crowd.
54 mins: Arsenal keep the ball for a while, but the closer they get to goal the less keen they seem to be to reach it.

52 mins: Madueke catches Perraud, who goes down, smacking the turf with a palm in apparent agony. So the referee blows his whistle, at which point Perraud’s agony magically evaporates, and he gets up.
51 mins: Arsenal do appear to have been instructed to get a move on, and the ball is zipping about with a bit more pace. Which is promising.
49 mins: Guimaraes takes the first shot of the second half, but it’s not very good, and floats harmlessly high and wide.
48 mins: … but that doesn’t lead to anything more than a goal kick.
47 mins: The first half ended(ish) with a couple of Arsenal corners and the second half has started similarly. This time they’re also going to get a third, which Rice is going to take.
46 mins: Peeeeeeep! Arsenal get the ball re-rolling.
The players are back out at the Emirates, with no halftimely changes.
Also in the Champions League tonight:
Atletico Madrid 1-0 Manchester United
Galatasaray 1-1 Barcelona Viking 2-0 Bayern Munich Lens 0-2 Sporting Sabah 2-0 Slavia Prague Internazionale 1-1 Club Brugge RB Leipzig 0-0 PSV Villarreal 2-1 Napoli

Arsenal have had two excellent chances, one created with a move down the right which ended with Guimaraes shooting wide, and one created with a move down the left which ended with Eze having a shot saved. They’ve been the better team, but Lille have been well organised and hard working, and goalless it remains.
45+1 mins: Save! Guimaraes’s deflected shot bamboozles Ozer, who can’t hold on to it and has to dive again to claw the ball off the toes of Gyokeres and out for a corner.
45 mins: … and his second attempt is cleared.
44 mins: Madueke takes the corner, which is headed behind for another corner.
43 mins: Madueke backheels into the path of the overlapping Timber, but he can’t pick out Gyokeres with his low cross, which is turned behind.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳苦战一小时后，在下半场八分钟内连入三球击败里尔。
bodyZh: 好啦，我的播报就到这里。再见！在我离开之前，再次附上埃德·阿隆斯的比赛报道：
作为临别赠礼，这里有西德·洛维关于曼联在马德里竞技失利的文章：
埃贝雷奇·埃泽对这场比赛进行了总结：
“表现不错。我们完成了需要做的事，踢得很放松并享受其中，这才是最重要的。很多球队来这里时都带着极高的斗志，所以上半场可能会相当艰难，但我们的目标是把对手慢慢磨垮。”
埃德·阿隆斯的比赛报道出炉了！
连胜场次延续到了十二场。在这个阿森纳缅怀俱乐部终身主席肯·弗里尔的夜晚——正是他在2006年促成了球队从海布里搬迁至酋长球场——米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在已经成为堡垒的主场又创造了一个欧冠里程碑，这再合适不过了。
近年来阿森纳在这里的统治力如此之强，以至于当萨卡面对顽强的里尔攻入第三球时，这是自三年前阿尔特塔率队重返欧洲顶级赛场以来，他们在联赛或小组赛中于酋长球场打进的第36个进球。
这里有更多内容：
在我们等待比赛报告的同时，这里有一篇关于英格兰女足在世界杯附加赛中5-0大胜希腊的报道：
今晚欧冠比赛的完整比分：
阿森纳 3-0 里尔 马德里竞技 2-0 曼联 加拉塔萨雷 1-4 巴塞罗那 国际米兰 3-4 布鲁日俱乐部 朗斯 0-2 里斯本竞技 RB莱比锡 1-0 埃因霍温 萨巴赫 2-0 布拉格斯拉维亚 维京 3-3 拜仁慕尼黑* 比利亚雷亚尔 3-1 那不勒斯
* 这里戏剧性十足：维京半场2-0领先，在迈克尔·奥利斯于第73分钟累计两张黄牌被罚下后以2-3落后，但他们在最后一分钟抢下了一个绝平球。
打破里尔防线的尤里恩·廷贝尔接受了采访：
“我在上半场有过一些机会。第一脚停球不错，这就完成了一半工作。然后诺尼在喊‘射门！射门！射门！’，所以我射门了。我没有想太多。我当时只想着‘我得射门’。我们需要那个首开纪录的进球。我们踢得不错，但我们需要那个进球。我们知道自己有多强。上半场我们有一些机会，踢得有点草率，但我们一直掌控着局面。我们只需继续前进。赛季还处于早期。”
90+4分钟：全场比赛结束！八分钟内的三粒进球帮助阿森纳战胜了防守组织出色但最终实力不济的里尔，里尔在下半场频繁丢球，付出了代价。
90+2分钟：哈弗茨对门将进行了一次有些过热的逼抢，在完成解围的后续动作中带倒了门将，被出示黄牌。
90+1分钟：进入伤停补时，大约会有三分钟左右。
90分钟：厄德高在拥挤的禁区内给多曼送出一记精妙的直传。虽然没有形成结果，但同样非常精彩。
88分钟：与此同时，在马德里，曼联落后两球且少一人作战。
85分钟：阿森纳用马克斯·多曼换下埃泽。
84分钟：阿森纳以散步般的节奏踢球，这在前一个小时的大部分时间里他们也差不多是这样，但现在感觉没那么让人恼火了。
82分钟：里尔用索里巴·迪亚乌内换下巴克瓦。
81分钟：戈菲因对埃泽犯规吃到黄牌，这次铲球非常糟糕，但还没严重到需要更严厉处罚的地步。
78分钟：当吉鲁替补上场换下上田时，得到了今晚迄今为止第四响亮的欢呼声。卡尔文·韦尔多恩替补上场换下佩罗，阿森纳则用本·怀特换下廷贝尔。
77分钟：里尔在距离自家球门40码处再次丢球，阿森纳形成四打二的局面，本应取得进球。但吉马良斯无意传球，而是在25码处起脚射门，被厄泽扑出。
77分钟：据说奥利维尔·吉鲁即将迎来他的高光时刻。
76分钟：场上没有约克雷斯对阿森纳的影响非常大。
73分钟：里尔险些获得机会！赖斯认为自己被犯规，但裁判示意比赛继续，皮球从右侧传到中路给巴克瓦，孔萨奋不顾身地挡出了他的射门。
73分钟：里尔换下本塔莱布和穆考，换上萨赫拉维和克亚尔高。
我经历过这场比赛还觉得悬念丛生的年代。三名替补球员联手制造了这个进球：厄德高在禁区右侧传给哈弗茨，哈弗茨回敲给萨卡，萨卡推射球门远角破门！
70分钟：扑救！阿森纳现在几乎势不可挡。萨卡从右侧的传中险些让赖斯抢到，几秒钟后埃泽突入禁区左侧，但厄泽伸手挡出了他的射门。
阿森纳扩大了领先优势，这个进球之所以格外美妙，是因为球是由前热刺中场球员纳比勒·本塔莱布“礼让”给他们的。皮球被传给右路的萨卡，萨卡的第一脚触球是传中到中路，埃泽的射门（我想）发生了折射后越过厄泽入网。
65分钟：阿森纳进行三人换让，马杜埃凯、梅里诺和约克雷斯下场，萨卡、厄德高和哈弗茨替补登场。
65分钟：马杜埃凯将球传给背身拿球的廷贝尔，廷贝尔的第一脚触球晃过安德烈，第二脚轻巧地挑射越过厄泽。这真的非常精彩。
凭借尤里恩·廷贝尔的精彩表现，阿森纳取得领先！
63分钟：里尔自中场休息以来就没能攻出本方半场。他们在控球方面表现糟糕，但在防守和战术组织上依然极其出色。
62分钟：阿尔特塔已经看够了，正准备让哈弗茨、萨卡和厄德高进行一次即时的三换。
61分钟：吉马良斯在禁区内尝试了一次360度旋转。当然，他丢了球，但那双脚的盘带太灵巧了！
60分钟：吉马良斯带球突入禁区倒地，这一次阿森纳队员提出了抗议。但裁判没有理会，VAR也没有介入。
59分钟：里尔在处理一个防守界外球时耗时太久，球被判给了阿森纳。但同样，什么也没创造出来。
57分钟：或许是阿森纳利用替补席的时候了——自中场休息以来唯一真正改变的，是看台上传出的抱怨声大小。
54分钟：阿森纳控球了一段时间，但他们离球门越近，似乎就越不想真正攻过去。
52分钟：马杜埃凯放倒了佩罗，后者倒地，手掌猛击草皮，显得痛苦万分。于是裁判吹响了哨子，就在此时，佩罗的痛苦神奇地消失了，他站了起来。
51分钟：阿森纳似乎得到了加快节奏的指示，皮球带着更高的速度来回传递。这很有希望。
49分钟：吉马良斯完成了下半场的首次射门，但质量不高，高高飞出底线，没有构成威胁。
48分钟：……但最终只赢得了一个球门球。
47分钟：上半场以几个阿森纳角球结束，下半场也以类似的方式开局。这一次他们还将获得第三个角球，由赖斯主罚。
46分钟：哔——！阿森纳重新开球。
球员们回到了酋长球场，中场休息时双方均未做出人员调整。
今晚的其他欧冠比赛情况：
马德里竞技 1-0 曼联
加拉塔萨雷 1-1 巴塞罗那 维京 2-0 拜仁慕尼黑 朗斯 0-2 里斯本竞技 萨巴赫 2-0 布拉格斯拉维亚 国际米兰 1-1 布鲁日俱乐部 RB莱比锡 0-0 埃因霍温 比利亚雷亚尔 2-1 那不勒斯
阿森纳有过两次绝佳机会，一次是通过右路配合由吉马良斯射门偏出，另一次是通过左路配合由埃泽的射门被扑出。他们是表现更好的一方，但里尔组织严密且拼抢积极，比分依然是平局。
45+1分钟：扑救！吉马良斯的折射射门让厄泽措手不及，他没能将球抱住，不得不再次倒地从约克雷斯脚下将球解围出底线。
45分钟：……他的第二次尝试被解围了。
44分钟：马杜埃凯主罚角球，皮球被头球解围出底线，又是一个角球。
43分钟：马杜埃凯脚后跟传球给前插的廷贝尔，但他的低平球传中没能找到约克雷斯，球被挡出底线。

bodyEn: Twelve wins in a row and counting. On a night when Arsenal remembered Ken Friar – the club’s life president who was instrumental in their move from Highbury to the Emirates in 2006 – it was fitting that Mikel Arteta’s side should rack up yet another Champions League milestone at their home that has become a fortress.

Such has Arsenal’s dominance been here in recent seasons that when Bukayo Saka slotted home their third against a dogged Lille side, it was the 36th goal they have scored at the Emirates in the league or group stage since returning to Europe’s top table under Arteta three years ago. In those 12 wins, they have remarkably conceded only three times.

Arsenal have also now racked up 14 successive league-stage victories in this competition – three short of Bayern Munich’s record – even if Arteta’s side were made to work for this one and had to wait until the 64th minute to find the breakthrough. That came from the unlikely source of Jurriën Timber after Arsenal’s second-string attack – and Viktor Gyökeres in particular – had looked laboured. But while Arteta may be concerned that it needed the introduction of Saka from the bench along with Martin Ødegaard and Kai Havertz to put this game to bed as Eberechi Eze added a second before Saka rounded off the scoring with a third in the space of seven minutes, they never looked in any danger of losing their proud record as Olivier Giroud received a standing ovation on his return to north London.

“I’m sure he is very happy to see how the boys played. But not only that, because I know how proud he felt about what we built,” said Arteta of Friar. “It’s a really sad day for everyone who loves football. The legacy that Ken is going to leave for this club is going to be for ever.”

Arsenal had earlier paid tribute to Friar, who worked his way up from the box office to club secretary before becoming managing director in the 1980s, when his death at the age of 92 was confirmed. The players wore black armbands as a mark of respect. Friar would have been especially proud of their formidable record here under Arteta in this competition that stretches back to the 2023-24 season, when they returned to the tournament after an absence of six years. It is little wonder that Arteta was so reluctant for redevelopment plans to go ahead given the disruption any temporary move away to Wembley or elsewhere would have caused.

Despite the absence of Piero Hincapié and Martín Zubimendi after they were both injured during the warm-down after the victory over Leeds on Saturday, the Arsenal manager was still able to make five changes. Lille’s manager, Davide Ancelotti, who worked under his father, Carlo, at Everton and Real Madrid among others before being appointed during the summer in only his second senior role, resisted the temptation to start with 40-year-old Giroud against his former club.

Restored to his favoured right flank after excelling on the left against Leeds, it had not been saying much that Noni Madueke had once again been Arsenal’s most dangerous outlet in a first half in which they struggled to create much against a deep-lying defence.

Bruno Guimarães and then Mikel Merino spurned decent chances, while Ayase Ueda had the ball in David Raya’s net after Nabil Bentaleb’s shot deflected off Timber and hit Hákon Haraldsson on the way through, with the video assistant referee confirming the Japan striker was marginally offside.
But Arsenal lacked creativity without Ødegaard and Gyökeres showing plenty of hustle and bustle yet making little real impact.

It summed Arsenal’s first half up when he could not get out of the way after Eze forced Berke Ozer into his first proper save and was promptly flagged offside. Ozer then had to scramble the ball away from the feet of the Sweden striker after spilling a shot from Guimarães on the stroke of half-time.

The referee, Felix Zwayer, waved away appeals at the start of the second half when Guimarães went down in the area under pressure from Alexsandro but the Arsenal midfielder seemed to be looking for the contact. A wayward effort that almost made it into the upper tier from Madueke was the signal for Arteta to summon Ødegaard, Saka and Havertz to get ready.

Before they had time to be introduced, Arsenal finally found the breakthrough when Madueke picked out Timber to apply a deft finish with his right foot after a brilliant first touch. Saka made an immediate impact by setting up Eze to dispatch the second with his left foot – possibly with the help of a deflection – less than three minutes later, before adding a third after combining with Havertz and Ødegaard. Lille must have wondered what had hit them.

As well as the chance to pay their respects to Giroud, the Arsenal fans were treated to a late cameo from the dazzling Max Dowman to round off another very satisfying evening that has become the norm.

items.titleZh: 廷贝尔精妙破门与替补萨卡建功助阿森纳击败里尔
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳豪取欧冠联赛阶段十二连胜，主场表现稳健。
bodyZh: 十二连胜仍在继续。在这个悼念俱乐部终身名誉主席肯·弗赖尔的夜晚——正是他在2006年促成了俱乐部从海布里搬迁至酋长球场——米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在已经成为堡垒的主场创下又一个欧冠里程碑，显得再合适不过。
近年来阿森纳在这里的统治力如此之强，以至于当布卡约·萨卡面对顽强的里尔打进球队的第三球时，这是自阿尔特塔三年前带领球队重返欧洲之巅以来，他们在酋长球场进行的联赛或小组赛中打进的第36个进球。在这12场胜利中，他们惊人地只丢了3球。

尽管阿尔特塔的球队为这场胜利付出了一番努力，直到第64分钟才打破僵局，但阿森纳目前已在这项赛事中取得了14场连续的联赛阶段胜利——距离拜仁慕尼黑的纪录只差3场。在阿森纳的第二套进攻阵容——尤其是维克托·哲凯赖什表现得有些沉闷之后，打破僵局的是不太为人所料的尤里恩·廷贝尔。虽然阿尔特塔或许会担心球队需要换上萨卡、马丁·厄德高和凯·哈弗茨才能锁定胜局——埃贝雷奇·埃泽打进第二球，随后萨卡在七分钟内攻入第三球锁定胜局——但随着重返北伦敦的奥利维尔·吉鲁获得全场起立鼓掌，他们从未面临失去这一骄人纪录的危险。
“我确信他非常高兴看到小伙子们踢得这么好。不仅如此，因为我知道他对我们所建树的一切感到多么骄傲，”阿尔特塔在谈到弗赖尔时说道。“对于每一个热爱足球的人来说，这都是非常悲伤的一天。肯为这家俱乐部留下的遗产将永远存在。”
此前阿森纳向弗赖尔致敬，他从售票处做起，一路晋升为俱乐部秘书，并在20世纪80年代成为董事总经理。在他的死讯以92岁高龄得到证实后，球员们佩戴黑纱以示敬意。如果弗赖尔看到球队在阿尔特塔带领下自2023-24赛季（当时他们在缺席六年重返该赛事）延续至今的强大主场战绩，一定会感到格外自豪。难怪阿尔特塔极其不愿推进任何会带来温布利或其他临时搬迁干扰的重建计划。
尽管皮耶罗·因卡皮耶和马丁·祖比门迪在周六战胜利兹联后的赛后放松训练中受伤缺阵，阿森纳主帅仍然能够做出五处人员调整。里尔主帅达维德·安切洛蒂曾在埃弗顿和皇家马德里等队在其父亲卡洛手下工作，今年夏天才被任命开启其仅有的第二份一线队主帅工作，他抵制了让40岁的吉鲁首发面对老东家的诱惑。
在对阵利兹联时在左路表现出色后回到他喜爱的右翼，诺尼·马杜埃凯再次成为阿森纳在上半场最具威胁的进攻点，当时他们在面对低位防守时创造机会困难。
布鲁诺·吉马良斯和随后米克尔·梅里诺错失了好机会，而上田绫世曾将球送入大卫·拉亚的网窝，当时纳比勒·本塔莱布的射门打在廷贝尔身上折射并击中哈康·哈拉尔德松，视频助理裁判确认这名日本前锋稍微越位。
但没有厄德高的阿森纳缺乏创造力，而哲凯赖什虽然拼抢积极，却没有产生什么实质性影响。

在简报推广之后
上半场的一个缩影是，当埃泽迫使贝尔克·厄泽做出第一次真正的扑救时，哲凯赖什未能及时闪开并随即被判越位。半场结束前，厄泽在扑救吉马良斯的射门时脱手，随后不得不从这名前锋脚下仓促解围。
下半场开始时，吉马良斯在亚历山德罗的压力下在禁区内倒地，主裁判菲利克斯·茨瓦尔挥手示意比赛继续，但这名阿森纳中场似乎是在寻找身体接触。马杜埃凯的一脚离谱射门几乎飞上了看台，这成为了阿尔特塔召唤厄德高、萨卡和哈弗茨做好准备的信号。
在他们替补登场之前，阿森纳终于打破了僵局。马杜埃凯妙传廷贝尔，后者用右脚完成了一脚精彩的停球后冷静推射破门。不到三分钟后，替补登场的萨卡立刻产生影响，助攻埃泽用左脚打进第二球——可能带有一点折射——随后萨卡与哈弗茨和厄德高配合打入第三球。里尔一定感到被打懵了。
除了有机会向吉鲁致敬，阿森纳球迷还欣赏到了表现惊艳的年轻小将马克斯·道曼在比赛尾声的登场，为又一个令人十分满意的常规夜晚画上了句号。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has admitted frustration after Piero Hincapié and Martín Zubimendi sustained ankle injuries during the warm-down after Arsenal’s win against Leeds on Saturday.

Both are due to have scans on Monday to determine the extent of the damage, although Arteta said they would miss the Champions League game at home to Lille on Tuesday and that Hincapié’s injury “looks a little bit more serious”.

“We had a training session planned after the game for the players,” the manager said. “They didn’t have enough minutes to get everybody in the right rhythm and in two very unfortunate actions, we lost two players.”

Arteta described it as “far from ideal” but dismissed suggestions he would change the post-match routine. “When they have to play, they have no rhythm, and when you ask them to play, they’re going to have no impact in the game,” he said. “That could happen at the Emirates; it never happened in the seven years I was here. It could happen the next day in the training session, and that has happened before, and hopefully it happens now and doesn’t happen again. What can you do? If I knew I had a crystal ball clear, I’d say: ‘Guys, go in the Jacuzzi, everybody, I’ll see you tomorrow.’”

Hincapié and Zubimendi were expected to feature against Lille having not started in the Premier League this season. Arteta seemed disappointed with Illan Meslier and his staff after the reserve goalkeeper gave Hincapié a piggyback off the pitch rather than waiting for a stretcher.

“That’s something else not to discuss here,” he said. “Today they’re going to have a further scan and probably tomorrow we’ll know more and then we’ll see how they’re going to go. Piero’s one looks a little bit more serious, I think, but we’ll have to wait and see.”

There was better news for Arsenal as William Saliba has resumed training on his own as he recovers from a back injury sustained at the World Cup. Arteta would not be drawn on when the France defender could be back and is determined not to rush his recovery. “We’re still talking about weeks,” he said.

Gabriel Magalhães is likely to be partnered by Ezri Konsa again against the Brazil defender’s former club on Tuesday. Gabriel insisted he would not hesitate to take another penalty in a shootout despite missing the crucial spot-kick in the Champions League final against Paris Saint-Germain. “I was sad, and I didn’t want to miss a penalty, but I have learned from this and if I have another opportunity, I will be ready to take it,” he said.

“He has been getting in great positions, getting shots, getting one-touch finishes and tap-ins,” he said. “That is the kind of unpredictability we have with that player, otherwise we know how the opponent is going to defend him. He is doing well. He could have had another four or five goals by now, easily. But if he continues like that, we know. When he talks about scoring a certain amount of goals, he … He needs to be thinking about scoring a certain amount of goals per game. If that shifts, that mentality, he will get into those positions and score more goals.”

items.titleZh: 因卡皮耶与祖比门迪赛后拉伸受伤，但阿森纳迎来萨利巴复出利好
items.summaryZh: 因卡皮耶与祖比门迪在赛后训练中脚踝受伤，将缺席欧冠比赛，萨利巴恢复个人训练。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳周六击败利兹联后，主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔承认，皮耶罗·因卡皮耶和马丁·祖比门迪在赛后拉伸训练中遭遇了脚踝受伤，这让他感到非常无奈。
两人都将在周一接受扫描检查以确定伤情严重程度，尽管阿尔特塔表示他们将缺席周二主场对阵里尔的欧冠比赛，并且因卡皮耶的伤势“看起来稍微严重一些”。
“我们在赛后为球员们安排了一堂训练课，”这位主帅说道，“有些球员的出场时间不够，无法让所有人都达到正确的节奏，但在两次非常不幸的对抗中，我们失去了两名球员。”
阿尔特塔将这形容为“远非理想”，但他否认会改变赛后常规安排。“当他们必须上场时却没有比赛节奏，而当你要求他们出场时，他们又无法对比赛产生影响，”他说道，“这可能会在酋长球场发生；在我在这里的七年里从未发生过。它也可能在第二天的训练中发生，以前也发生过，希望现在发生了就不要再发生了。你能怎么办呢？如果我知道的话，我会说：‘伙计们，大家都去泡按摩浴缸吧，我们明天见。’"
因卡皮耶和祖比门迪本有望在对阵里尔的比赛中登场，因为他们本赛季尚未在英超联赛中首发出场。对于替补门将伊兰·梅利耶及其工作人员在因卡皮耶受伤后选择将其背离球场而不是等待担架的做法，阿尔特塔显得有些不满。
“这是另一件不需要在这里讨论的事情，”他说道，“今天他们将接受进一步的扫描，可能明天我们会了解更多信息，然后看看他们的情况如何。我认为皮耶罗的情况看起来稍微严重一些，但我们必须拭目以待。”
对于阿森纳来说也有一个好消息，威廉·萨利巴在世界杯期间遭遇背部伤势后，目前已经恢复了个人训练。阿尔特塔没有透露这位法国后卫何时能够复出，并决心不急于让他复出。“我们讨论的仍然是几周时间，”他说。
周二对阵这位巴西后卫的前东家时，加布里埃尔·马加良斯很可能再次与埃兹里·孔萨搭档。加布里埃尔坚称，尽管在对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的欧冠决赛点球大战中罚失了关键点球，但他如果再次面对点球时绝不会犹豫。“我很难过，我不想罚丢点球，但我从中吸取了教训，如果我还有机会，我随时准备主罚，”他说。

阿尔特塔向布卡约·萨卡提出了进球更多、要求更高的挑战，此前这位前锋在最近四次代表英格兰出场中攻入五球，并透露他们一直在努力将他轮换到更靠中央的区域来完成终结。
“他一直处于极佳的位置，能够完成射门、一脚触球破门和补射，”他说道，“这就是我们在该球员身上所拥有的那种不可预测性，否则我们就会知道对手将如何防守他。他做得很好。他到现在本可以轻松再进四到五个球。但如果他继续这样下去，我们心知肚明。当他谈论打进一定数量的进球时，他……他需要考虑的是每场比赛打进一定数量的进球。如果这种心态发生转变，他就会进入那些位置并攻入更多进球。”

items.summaryEn: Manchester City unrepentant in victory, Spurs make progress of a sort and Noni Madueke meets the momentThe manner of Manchester City’s victory at Liverpool was an article of both vindication and vilification.
